choices.text: Add logging around the district feed and dig through yesterday’s records until you find the cause.
Call the grower to hear exactly what he saw before writing any code.
Ship a quick in-app warning when district data looks out of range while you investigate.

response.text: At your small ag-tech company in Manteca, a grower says the irrigation scheduling app showed the wrong water allocation for his almond block yesterday. The data came from the irrigation district’s feed, and you can’t reproduce it.
response.title: Grower’s bug report
